name: ALVAS 爱瓦士 DA54
why_interesting: A dated mainland DA54 price lead now has exact manufacturer identity, construction and fit evidence; ALVAS is the correct brand spelling.

facts.frame_material: ALVAS X1 high-modulus carbon frame and carbon fork; the live global page does not publish a fiber supplier, grade or lay-up
facts.frame_construction: Aero-shaped endurance-road frame with fully internal routing, T47 bottom bracket, 12x142/12x100 thru axles, flat-mount brakes and SRAM UDH compatibility
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Bike Insights' exact 2025 DA54 record reports 32 mm and attributes its geometry data to alvas.bike; the live manufacturer text shows fitted 28C tires but does not state the maximum
facts.reference_builds: Current global Ultegra Di2/Vision SL60 and Australian 105 Di2/Helux R60 builds prove multiple regional trims; neither is assigned to the dated mainland listing
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness test or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness assessment was found; regional marketing and general responsiveness impressions are not treated as measurements
facts.geometry: Exact manufacturer DA54 sheet, lengths mm and angles ° explicitly labelled. Columns size / seat tube / seat angle / top tube / head tube / head angle / fork rake / wheelbase / chainstay / reach / standover / stack: XS 443 / 73.5 / 519 / 86 / 70.5 / 42 / 971 / 410 / 372 / 717 / 498; S 473 / 73.5 / 533 / 106 / 71.5 / 42 / 976 / 410 / 378 / 748 / 521; M 503 / 73.5 / 549 / 123 / 72.75 / 42 / 983 / 410 / 390 / 778 / 539; L 533 / 73.5 / 559 / 144 / 73.25 / 42 / 988 / 410 / 393 / 804 / 560; XL 563 / 73.5 / 572 / 164 / 73.25 / 42 / 1002 / 410 / 401 / 828 / 580. Regional cockpit / crank selections on the same sheet are not assigned to the mainland listing.

missing: Exact mainland drivetrain, wheels, cockpit and complete-bike weight for the selected listing option
Primary confirmation of the secondary 32 mm maximum-clearance value and meaningful frame-stiffness evidence
Current domestic warranty route and final checkout conditions
source_note: The original ALUMS text was a transcription error; current manufacturer and regional records consistently use ALVAS / 爱瓦士. The global and Australian pages publish different complete builds, so the retained CNY 11,439 listing remains trim-ambiguous. A reviewed Australian Ultegra build weighed 8.4 kg with pedals, but that value is not transferred to the mainland listing.

enrichment_reviews.scope: Exact current source additions; existing observations, conflicts and collection dates retained.
